reason: The cited evidence shows Al addition promotes Al2O3 formation and improves oxidation resistance in CoCrNiAl and AlCrTiZrMo systems, but none of the evidence involves refractory HEAs like WMoTaNbV or the specific 1200°C/pure oxygen condition. The claim that 5 at% Al suffices in this system and that the base alloy oxidizes rapidly is unsupported by the cited passages.
premises: Aluminum addition promotes formation of a continuous, adherent Al2O3 scale in refractory HEAs
Al2O3 scale acts as a barrier to oxygen diffusion, reducing oxidation rate
~5 at% Al is sufficient to form a protective Al2O3 scale at 1200°C
The base alloy (e.g., WMoTaNbV) without Al forms less protective oxides and oxidizes rapidly
Homogeneous Al distribution is achievable via conventional processing
